title: Dispatcher Stub & Fallback Remediation
description: Fix broken fallback chains, dead compute() calls, and stub actions across dispatchers. exportDispatcher has broken engine.generate() fallback, automationDispatcher has 5 dead .compute() fallback branches, batch_export returns 'queued' without processing, knowledgeDispatcher 'relations' returns 'not yet implemented'.
findings: exportDispatcher render_setup_sheet fallback calls engine.generate() which doesn't exist on ReportEngine
automationDispatcher has 5 actions with dead .compute() catch branches
batch_export returns { status: 'queued' } but never processes items

steps.instruction: Read exportDispatcher.ts and identify all fallback branches calling engine.generate()
Replace broken generate() calls with correct ReportEngine method (renderPdf, renderHtml, etc.)
Implement real batch_export processing: iterate items, call render_* for each, collect results
Add progress tracking metadata to batch response
Add smoke tests for render and batch_export actions
Read automationDispatcher.ts and identify all .compute() fallback branches
For each: determine correct engine method from primary handler above the catch
Replace dead .compute() with correct engine method call, or remove the fallback if primary is reliable
Add tests for the 5 affected actions

units.title: Implement or Remove Stub Actions

steps.instruction: Implement knowledgeDispatcher 'relations' action using KnowledgeGraphEngine.getRelations() or graph traversal
Grep for any remaining 'not yet implemented' strings across all dispatchers
For each stub found: implement using existing engine capabilities or remove from action enum
Run full test suite to verify no regressions

exit_conditions: Zero 'not yet implemented' strings in dispatcher code

deliverables: All stub actions implemented or removed
